text_block_list.text:
This year, Симболи Рудольф will finally be

competing at the senior level.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We've come together to the shrine to
pray for her
success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It seems the instructors are already here.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Hello there, Rudolf! Here for a New
Year's visit,
are you?
text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Instructor A

text_block_list.text: Indeed. Happy New Year to you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I mean to visit again later with the rest of
the
student council, but I thought I
might pay an
informal visit first. I hope
you don't mind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I presume you'll be praying
for success
in your races?
text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Instructor B

text_block_list.text:
Of course. Although, considering my
position, it
would only be proper to pray
for the success of
the academy as well.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You're always in president mode, aren't
you?
That's why the students all say they
can rely on
you!
text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Instructor C

text_block_list.text: Rely... on me?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A shadow falls over Rudolf's face for a
moment,
but it leaves as quickly as it
arrives.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: My parents did always say they needed to keep a... "real eye" on me to keep me out of mischief.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well, if that ain't the "punniest" thing
I've heard
all day! Gahaha!
text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Instructor A

text_block_list.text:
"Punniest"? D-dear me, that's a good
one...
Ahahaha!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm getting the impression that the
teachers share
Rudolf's sense of humor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Eventually, the teachers leave...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hrm...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...But Rudolf still seems to have
something on her
mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I expect to hear the reason why her
expression
clouded over a few minutes
ago, but instead...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I fear I have embarrassed myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I concocted a falsehood for the sake of a
joke...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was never an especially mischievous
child, let
alone infamous for such
behavior.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That joke I told was a fabrication. And I
should
know better than anyone that
reflecting reality is
the essence of
comedy...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The idea suddenly appeared in my mind,
and I
acted rashly on the impulse. I
regret my actions
entirely...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's. We have no time to be
agonizing over
crimes against comedy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Our schedule is full to bursting. Even this
shrine
visit is pressed for time.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: This year's off to a busy start, eh?

text_block_list.text: The start of a new year is always busy.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We have associates to greet, New Year's

gatherings to attend, leftover work from
the
previous year... Our duties are many
and varied.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So, seeing as we have so little time, let's
get to
the point.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
They say that a wish cannot survive
being put into
words, but they also say
that a promise made is a
promise kept.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And I would prefer to speak our wishes
aloud, so
that we might share them.
What do you think?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Then tell me your wish for this year.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Good health. I want you to eat healthy.

Dominance. I want you to be the greatest
Emperor in history.
Culture. I want you to refine your comedy.

text_block_list.text:
A fine idea. Every Umamusume should
strive for
the same.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And with my time at such a premium this
year, it
will be all the more important to
remain conscious
of what I consume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I may know how to
make the
perfect start.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I notice a certain drink is on offer at the
stall over
there.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That's the one. What say we sample
some?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Surely we can take a five-minute break
in the
name of good health.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Dominance? Well, now. That is quite the

audacious goal.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Are you asking me to rise to the same
level as the
deities of myth?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The road will be long and arduous... but
then, I
wouldn't have it any other way.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And besides, I do admire that you can
make such
grand declarations without
batting an eyelid.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Oho? Could it be?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Have you finally opened your eyes to
the
possibilities of puns?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If you helped me refine my art, it would
save me
from embarrassments like the
one before.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We should hold a study session as soon
as
possible. Could you come prepared
with some
ideas?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Let's see... a hundred should be
sufficient.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If you would be so kind. Fear not; I too
will bring
my best material.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Some time later, Симболи Рудольф and I
hold a
pun-storming session, to which
she really brings
her A-game.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The work we put in is no joke. I think it
has paid
off, even if there's still a long
way to go.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Very well, let us walk the path of
dominance
together. I trust this year will
be our greatest yet.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф and I clink our cups
together as
we enjoy a brief reprieve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
